notes: All 15 native GPU runs and all 6 PushT GPU runs are retained; v1/v2 are diagnostic versions, not final source qualification.
V1 excluded initially requested sources from tracked names; same-cycle retry dropped gluestick, and the new gate rejected it.
V2 uses all nine tracked names; native loaders and scene activation discard only the CURRENT active source. No source algorithm was patched.
V2 episode observer included background capture-only planning. V3 tags both worlds and outcomes by original capture-only flag and foreground thread.
Only V3 foreground source-completed and fully observed transport can qualify the requested object; another target success is not substitution.
Original candidates, seeds, poses, geometry, margins, native retries and success thresholds were not changed.
Coverage of names is not physical collision-geometry qualification. Contact-stage compatibility remains scoped outside full transport.
PushT uses unchanged authored low-table fixtures, not measured hardware geometry or pushing physics.
Real SDK, camera, motion and browser UI validation remain NOT_RUN in this GPU matrix.
